card.line: Salim was a town near Aenon, where John the Baptist was baptizing near plentiful water, and it marks the place of his last baptisms.

moments.title: John baptizes near Salim
moments.text: John was baptizing at Aenon near Salim because the water was plentiful there. People kept coming to be baptized.

moments.title: John points to Jesus
moments.text: John's disciples told him that Jesus was baptizing and everyone was going to Him. John said he is not the Christ but was sent ahead of Him, and his joy in hearing the bridegroom's voice was complete.
